name: Fermoselle (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue in the proportions three to one, the white charged with a red castle.
history: The arms and flag of Fermoselle were approved in 1999 by resolution of the governing committee of the Diputación of Zamora and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 1 June 1999; the arms are argent a castle gules masoned sable and pierced azure, in base waves azure and argent, and the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two horizontal stripes in proportions 3/4 and 1/4, white with a red castle above and blue below.

features.role: castle with blue door and windows
